preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()]) or True
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of traits n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Each trait line starts with size ki (1 <= ki <= 100) followed by ki positive integers <= 1000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(x.isdigit() for x in line.split()) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two space-separated non-negative integers representing RK's and RG's swag levels.

For each test case, the two integers represent the optimal total sums collected by RK and RG respectively, assuming both play optimally to maximize their own sum in a game where RK takes from the front and RG takes from the back of any non-empty trait.
